steps.en: Start skill scaffolding with your own coding agent
steps.zh: 和自己的编码 agent 一起启动 skill 生成

steps.en: Prints a three-phase prompt: your agent maps the domain, interviews you, writes SKILL.md files
steps.zh: 打印三阶段提示词：agent 梳理领域、访谈你、写出 SKILL.md

steps.en: Validate the skills and copy the CI template
steps.zh: 校验 skill，并拷入 CI 模板

steps.en: Publish the package as usual; skills ride inside the tarball
steps.zh: 照常发包，skill 随 tarball 一起发出

steps.en: Users' agents list and load the SKILL.md of the version they installed
steps.zh: 用户的 agent 列出并加载其已装版本的 SKILL.md

steps.en: After each release, flags skills whose sources changed and opens a review PR
steps.zh: 每次发版后标出源文件已变的 skill，开复查 PR

value.en: Your agent guidance ships and versions with your package, and you hear about it when it goes stale
value.zh: 给 agent 的说明随包发布、随版本走，过期时会被点名

sources: docs/getting-started/quick-start-maintainers.md (TanStack/intent main @ 305ca7f, 2026-09-13): 'npx @tanstack/intent@latest scaffold' (three phases: domain discovery, tree generation, skill generation), 'npx @tanstack/intent@latest validate', 'npx @tanstack/intent@latest setup' copies check-skills.yml, 'npm publish', check-skills.yml opens a PR flagging stale skills
docs/overview.md: 'npx @tanstack/intent@latest list' and 'npx @tanstack/intent@latest load @tanstack/query#fetching' load SKILL.md for the installed package version
npx @tanstack/intent@0.4.0 --help (run 2026-09-28): scaffold, validate, setup, list, load commands present in the released CLI
